summary.text: Bret Martel is the Republican candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 95, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in a race with no incumbent.
Martel advanced unopposed from the June 9, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Kiernan Majerus-Collins.
